title: Correct U_AB calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates U_AB = W_AB / q using the given work and charge, obtaining -30 V.

title: Correct U_BC calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates U_BC = W_BC / q, accounting for work done against the force, obtaining 30 V.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Student determines the magnitude of the uniform electric field as 200 V/m using geometry and potential differences.

title: Electric field direction
description: Important: Student identifies the correct direction of the electric field (e.g., from B towards D or equivalent description).

title: Work sign interpretation
description: Important: Student correctly interprets the sign of work (done by vs. against the force) when calculating potential differences.

title: Geometry application
description: Important: Student uses the triangle geometry (30° angle, BC length) to find the relevant distance component parallel to the field.

title: Equipotential line recognition
description: Optional: Student notes that points A and C are at the same potential, simplifying the field calculation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm to m) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in U_AB
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in U_AB, e.g., forgetting the negative charge or misinterpreting work direction.

title: Incorrect field formula
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly applies E = U/d using the wrong potential difference or geometric distance.
